items.guidance: In this Express app, look in the main server file where the app and routers are mounted; if adding the route, register it on the Express app before any auth, passport, redirect, or host-check middleware so the load balancer can reach it on port 3000. Report the chosen path so it can be set as the Deployz health check path.

Search the source for bull Queue instantiation and .process() calls and trace whether the module that registers processors is imported by the file that npm start runs. Report the file and whether processing happens in the web process or in a separate entry point, and whether any package.json script or Procfile already references it.

Search for kafkajs imports and KAFKA_BROKERS reads, and check whether they are reachable from the code npm start runs or only from optional or conditional paths. Report the files, whether an env setting gates the Kafka usage, and whether startup fails without KAFKA_BROKERS.
